answer:
**Myanmar**

According to the World Bank's Global Findex 2021 data, the proportion of adults who used a mobile phone or the internet to pay a bill in 2021 was:

| Country | Bill‑payment users (2021) |
|---------|---------------------------|
| Cambodia | ~14 % |
| Laos | ~17 % |
| **Myanmar** | ~12 % |

All three countries fall below the 20 % threshold.  
When the 2021 GDP (current US$) is examined:

| Country | GDP, 2021 (US $ bn) |
|---------|---------------------|
| **Myanmar** | 73.9 bn |
| Cambodia | 27.8 bn |
| Laos | 20.7 bn |

Thus, **Myanmar had the highest GDP in 2021** among Southeast Asian countries with less than 20 % of respondents using a mobile phone or the internet to pay bills.
